question: The noted danseuse Yamini Krishnamurthy opened Yamini School of Dance in ________, in the year 1990.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The noted danseuse **Yamini Krishnamurthy** opened **Yamini School of Dance in Delhi**, in the year** 1990**.
 
• Mungara Yamini Krishnamurthy is a distinguished Indian dancer proficient in **both Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi styles**.
 
• Making her debut in **1957 in Madras,** she holds the prestigious title of Asthana Nartaki (resident dancer) of the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam.
 
• Krishnamurthy is revered as a torchbearer of the Kuchipudi dance form.
 
• She actively imparts her knowledge of dance to aspiring artists through her institute, the Yamini School of Dance, located in Hauz Khas, New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Krishnamurthy** has received numerous awards, including the **Padma Shree in 1968, Padma Bhushan in 2001, and Padma Vibhushan in 2016**, which are among the highest civilian honors in India.
 
• Krishnamurthy's contributions to the field of dance have been recognized and celebrated.
 
• She was honored with the "Natya Shastra" award by the Shambhavi School of Dance during the **"Nayika-Excellence Personified" **event on Women's Day in 2014.
 
• Additionally, she delivered a lecture demonstration on the "Contribution of Woman to Kuchipudi" and released a Kuchipudi Dance DVD featuring Prateeksha Kashi, daughter of Kuchipudi Dansuse Smt. Vyjayanthi Kashi, the artistic director of Shambhavi.
